note: WP-5 unit side (mutate-multi.js list key 'wp5-unit', proof null: jest --runTestsByPath the named suite, no database). Mocked-Prisma suites are not certification evidence (plan section 1.4): these entries only show that the unit gate also turns red beside the live catch. They run on HEAD (no WP-2 batch, HR-C1 fix or WP-5 fix plan rewrites these suites). Each entry's tests are the titles that must fail; every title was checked to exist in its suite at HEAD (mutsyntax-wp5.js). The unmutated suites must pass first (WP5-RUN-PLAN.md section 7.4). Run one id per invocation, quoted and with a trailing comma ("--only=M-AVL,") and always with --lists=<key>: mutate-multi.js matches a value without a comma as a PREFIX (M-AVL would also run M-AVLa and M-AVLb; M-PCL0 also M-PCL0i and M-PCL0k; M-PCLg also M-PCLga and M-PCLgb), PowerShell drops an unquoted trailing comma, and ids such as M1 or G1 repeat across other lists.
noUnitCatcher: M-PCL0k (acknowledged -> closed): no case closes an acknowledged order ('walks request -> approval -> issue -> acknowledgement' stops at acknowledged; every close case is issued). Live catcher O2.J.ack.forceWithReason only.

M-AVLb (the per-bin available check): no case issues from a named bin past its reservation; every unreserved over-issue is refused by postMovement's on-hand check first (inventory.service.js:743). Live catcher N1.J.issue41bin only.

INV_INSUFFICIENT_AVAILABLE itself: no suite asserts the code. UM-AVL and UM-AVLa reach the mutated branch through its INV_INSUFFICIENT_STOCK leg (reserved 0: the same if, :1031-1039), not through the reservation.
